==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ziegler:''' Tar, I've been thinking... maybe I should just join a gang.
:'''Tar:''' ...What are you on about now?
:'''Ziegler:''' I'm serious. I'm just a guy with no talent... it seems impossible for me to get ahead in life.
:'''Ziegler:''' Have you seen that play, Like a Hippocamp? I want to be like the Mafia in it.
:'''Ziegler:''' I'll fight with my fists and live by loyalty and passion, carving out my own place in the world!
:'''Ziegler:''' So, what do you say, Tar? Want to join me on this journey?
:'''Tar:''' I think...
:'''Ziegler:''' It's great?
:'''Tar:''' No, I think you should get a job. If anything, you could go herd sheep in town. I know people.
:'''Ziegler:''' You think I'm joking, don't you?
:'''Tar:''' Ziegler, buddy, the gangs are a thing of the past...
:'''Tar:''' Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
:'''Ziegler:''' Not really.
:'''Tar:''' If there were, they'd have been locked up in the Order Tribunal or recruited by the families.
:'''Ziegler:''' But still, I believe gangs like that exist in real life!
:'''Tar:''' You're a lost cause. Who actually takes stories from a play seriously?!
{{Dialogue End}}
